summary: Indonesia Livestock PWA (React+Vite+TS, Dexie, Zustand) tested end-to-end via mobile viewport (390x844) using Playwright. All 9 requested flows work correctly: dashboard summary cards read seeded Dexie data (5 total, 3 pens, 1 quarantine, 3 pending), header online + pending badge, bottom nav, Scan manual lookup (both success and 'not found'), livestock detail, Health form save (pending 3->4, synced:false), Quarantine start on ACTIVE animal (status -> Karantina, pending increments), Quarantine sheet for already-quarantined LIVESTOCK-0004 exposes recover + deceased buttons, Add Data creates livestock and returns to dashboard incrementing total, Profile sync clears pending to 0 with 'Berhasil sinkron N data' toast and updates lastSynced. No blocking issues found. Non-blocking: React Router v6 future-flag warnings in console.
action_items: (Optional) Silence React Router v6 future-flag warnings by opting into v7_startTransition and v7_relativeSplatPath futures in <BrowserRouter future={{...}}> — cosmetic only, no functional impact.
critical_code_review_comments: syncService and useAppStore correctly filter synced===false in JS since IndexedDB cannot index booleans — noted with clear comments; good.
Livestock unique indexes (&rfid_uid, &register_number) properly enforced; AddData.tsx catches ConstraintError and shows Indonesian toast — good.
Quarantine transaction updates livestock.status and inserts quarantineLog atomically — correct.
Toast wrapper uses pointer-events-none with inner pointer-events-auto so it does not block underlying tap targets — good.
seed_data_creation: None manually created. Dexie seeded on first load per src/db/seed.ts (1 owner, 3 pens, 5 livestock, 5 health logs, 1 quarantine log, 1 schedule).
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is Vite dev server on :3000 (not Expo). Use mobile viewport 390x844. IndexedDB (DB name: IndonesiaLivestockDB) persists across reloads, so pending count may not equal seed value (3) on re-runs; open in a fresh incognito context or delete the DB before tests that assert exact counts. Web NFC unavailable in headless Chromium — use manual-id-input.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs to root-cause. During the first automated run, opening the quarantine sheet on LIVESTOCK-0001 immediately after a health-form save timed out once; a second isolated run on LIVESTOCK-0002 succeeded (badge Aktif -> Karantina, pending 3->4). Likely a transient animation timing race in the first run, not a functional defect.
